def observed_now(obs) -> np.ndarray:

def ee_row(
    left_position: Sequence[float],
    left_quaternion_xyzw: Sequence[float],
    left_gripper: float,
    right_position: Sequence[float],
    right_quaternion_xyzw: Sequence[float],
    right_gripper: float,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Pack one ee_pose row in the documented xyzw world-frame layout."""
    row = np.r_[
        left_position,
        left_quaternion_xyzw,
        left_gripper,
        right_position,
        right_quaternion_xyzw,
        right_gripper,
    ].astype(np.float32)
